topic: Go tracer 'lost traces' after major upgrade
environment: Tracer upgraded across a major version
symptom_pattern: After upgrading the Go tracing library to a new major version, apps intermittently log 'lost N traces' and 'Error sending stats payload: connection reset by peer'; trace-agent logs show i/o timeouts.
root_cause: The tracer keeps idle keep-alive connections for 90s while older Agents close idle connections after 5s; reusing a closed connection loses the payload. Fixed in a later tracer minor; a newer Agent with a longer idle timeout mitigates.
resolution_path: Correlate errors with the upgrade and gather tracer and Agent versions
Collect a flare and tracer debug logs
Upgrade to the fixed tracer minor, or upgrade the Agent as a mitigation; involve APM engineering if unclear
info_needed: frequency and timing of the errors

qa_pairs.tse_question: Which exact tracer and Agent versions are running?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Tracer v2.0.x on all services; Agent is 7.6-something, we haven't upgraded it this year.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Are you seeing CPU or memory throttling on the Agent pods?

customer_style.tone: senior SRE, precise, expects engineering-level depth
